name_zh: 季蒂奇/波黑/代顿/族裔：代顿协议与族裔权力分享
description_zh: 佐兰·季蒂奇 (1952-2003) / 阿利雅·伊泽特贝戈维奇 (1925-2003) 波黑总理/总统/1992-1995/波黑/战争/萨拉热窝/围城/斯雷布雷尼察/种族/清洗/代顿/协议/1995/实体/联邦/塞族/克罗族/波族/权力/分享/总统/轮值/季蒂奇/改革/2003/遇刺/遗产/波黑/代顿/族裔。核心模式：代顿族裔权力分享 — 代顿/实体/轮值/总统/族裔/权力/分享/遗产/季蒂奇/波黑。体现 M251 代顿/族裔权力分享 — 以"代顿+实体+轮值+族裔"四位一体，在战争/种族清洗/国际干预/族裔仇恨四重创伤中构建波黑代顿族裔权力分享范式。
description_en: Zoran Djindjic (1952-2003) / Alija Izetbegovic (1925-2003) Bosnia PM/President/1992-1995/Bosnia/war/Sarajevo/siege/Srebrenica/ethnic/cleansing/Dayton/Accords/1995/entities/federation/Serb/Croat/Bosniak/power/sharing/presidency/rotation/Djindjic/reform/2003/assassination/legacy/Bosnia/Dayton/ethnicity. Core model: Dayton Ethnic Power-Sharing — Dayton/entities/rotation/presidency/ethnic/power/sharing/legacy/Djindjic/Bosnia. Exemplifies M251 Dayton/Ethnic Power-Sharing — quaternity of 'Dayton + entities + rotation + ethnicity' building Bosnian Dayton ethnic power-sharing paradigm amid quadruple trauma of war/ethnic cleansing/international intervention/ethnic hatred.
reason_zh: 波黑代顿模式非单纯和平协议，而是"代顿+实体+轮值+族裔"四位一体后冲突治理。以两个实体划分领土，以轮值总统平衡三族，以国际监督确保执行。M251 区隔于 M146 南非真相(曼德拉)、M240 秘鲁真相(贝尔蒙德)、M250 马其顿名字(米塞夫)，核心在于"代顿即停战框架+实体即领土妥协+轮值即权力制衡+族裔即政治常数"的波黑代顿族裔权力分享范式。
reason_en: Bosnian Dayton model not mere peace accord but 'Dayton + entities + rotation + ethnicity' quaternity post-conflict governance. Two entities divided territory, rotating presidency balanced three peoples, international oversight ensured implementation. M251 distinct from M146 South Africa TRC (Mandela), M240 Peru Truth (Belmonde), M250 Macedonia Name (Misirkov), core: 'Dayton as ceasefire framework + entities as territorial compromise + rotation as power balance + ethnicity as political constant' Bosnian Dayton ethnic power-sharing paradigm.
